description_en: Collects tasks in the task center
name: DescribeHistoryTasksStat

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The status of the task. Valid values:

Scheduled
Running
Succeed
Failed
Cancelling
Canceled
Waiting

Separate multiple statuses with commas (,). By default, this parameter is left empty. This indicates that tasks in all statuses are queried
parameters.help_zh:
任务状态，取值说明：
Scheduled：等待执行
Running：执行中
Succeed：执行成功
Failed：执行失败
Cancelling：正在终止
Canceled：已终止
Waiting：等待预设时间

如有多个状态则用英文逗号分隔，默认为空，表示全选
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.name: from_start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Only tasks that have a start time earlier than or equal to the time specified by this parameter are queried. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 任务开始时间的结束时间，表示查询任务开始时间在此时间之前的任务。按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC +0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: to_start_time

parameters.help_en: The minimum execution duration of a task. This parameter is used to filter tasks whose execution duration is longer than the minimum execution duration. Unit: seconds. The default value is 0, which indicates that no limit is imposed
parameters.help_zh: 任务执行耗时的最小值。用于筛选任务执行耗时大于此时间的任务，单位秒。默认0，表示不限制
parameters.name: from_exec_time

parameters.help_en: The maximum execution duration of a task. This parameter is used to filter tasks whose execution duration is shorter than or equal to the maximum execution duration. Unit: seconds. The default value is 0, which indicates that no limit is imposed
parameters.help_zh: 任务执行耗时的最大值。用于筛选任务执行耗时不小于此时间的任务，单位秒。默认0，表示不限制
parameters.name: to_exec_time
